name: @neylonai/sdk
description: Neylon AI public browser SDK — SupportWidget + API client

scripts.build: rm -rf dist-tmp tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --outDir dist-tmp && tailwindcss -i src/widget.css -o dist-tmp/widget.css --minify && rm -rf dist && mv dist-tmp dist && node build-embed.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build && pnpm run check-boundary
scripts.check-boundary: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function walk(d,acc=[]){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p,acc);else if(/\.(ts|tsx|js|d\.ts)$/.test(e.name))acc.push(p);}return acc;}const roots=['src','dist'].filter((r)=>fs.existsSync(r));const bad=[];for(const root of roots){for(const f of walk(root)){const t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(/from\s+['\"]@neylonai\/(?!sdk)/.test(t)||/require\(\s*['\"]@neylonai\/(?!sdk)/.test(t))bad.push(f);}}if(bad.length){console.error('SDK boundary violation — private @neylonai/* import in:\n'+bad.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}console.log('SDK boundary OK (no private @neylonai/* imports)');"
